answer: Proof of Stake acts as a sybil resistance mechanism by tethering identity to capital, forcing an attacker to accumulate assets to gain influence. As the validator set grows, the cost of a takeover creates a financial spiral that forces adversaries to reach a knoll of investment intensity impossible to sustain. By treating stake as a digital raven that carries consensus weight, the protocol ensures that each additional identity requires proportional economic sacrifice, effectively pricing out bulk identity creation.
